subject: Acme Health MAP: deployment mode trajectory, region lock, and legal timing
messages:
From: Natalie Rios <natalie.rios@acmehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Liu <evan.liu@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP kickoff and hosting/region preferences

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — the team liked the latency numbers and the model catalog options. Procurement asked me to capture a short Mutual Action Plan (attached) so we can align on decisions and PO timing. Two specific asks from my side to help accelerate: 

- Deployment mode: we want a recommendation from Redwood on whether to start on Hosted (fastest) vs Dedicated (predictable throughput) vs Private (VPC) given our SLA needs and PHI scope.
- Region: primary preference is us-east for redundancy with our primary DB; secondary is us-west.

Timeline constraints: Procurement is aiming to have a PO issued by 2026-09-15 to meet our Q4 initiative. That means we need to freeze architecture and finalize legal/terms by 2026-09-01.

I've attached our internal evaluation criteria and a first-pass MAP (Acme_MAP_draft_v1.pdf). Can you confirm what evidence we should expect for SOC2 and what a minimal SOW would look like if we opt for Dedicated?

Thanks — looking for a short decision matrix and proposed cadence for the next 3 weeks.

—Natalie
Director of Product
Acme Health

Attachments: Acme_MAP_draft_v1.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Rios <natalie.rios@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-11T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff and hosting/region preferences

Natalie —

Appreciate the clarity and the MAP. I reviewed the attachment and sketched a short matrix below that maps risk/timeline to recommended mode. I'll attach a redline SOW template and the SOC2 attestation PDF.

Quick recommendation (summary):
- Start on Dedicated in us-east (best balance of throughput predictability and control for PHI).
- Hosted is viable if you need the fastest time-to-market and are comfortable with our hosted-data controls; we'd recommend a staged migration to Dedicated within 3–6 months if usage grows.
- Private (VPC) is the long-term option for strict networking isolation but will add 6–12 weeks for delivery and legal/KMS work.

Proposed 3-week cadence:
1) Week 1 (now): finalize deployment decision and region lock — provide PO target date (you mentioned 09/15).
2) Week 2: procurement & legal review SOW and security artifacts; Redwood provides SOC2 attestation and architecture diagram.
3) Week 3: Integration plan and test account; pilot traffic to verify latency and KV cache behavior.

Attachments: SOC2_Attestation.pdf, SOW_draft_acme.docx

Action items for Acme: confirm preferred mode (Hosted/Dedicated/Private) and region, confirm PO target date.

I will loop in Monica and Priyom to scope the Dedicated sizing and CS handoffs.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Folks — forwarding Acme's MAP and my reply. Short notes:

- If Acme picks Dedicated in us-east, estimate initial capacity requirement: 2x A100-equivalent (production), 1x for staging. Priyom, can you validate that sizing and whether we should recommend quantized weights for cost containment?
- Monica, CS will need a 2-week onboarding window plus an ops runbook; if they want Private, add 6–8 weeks for VPC and KMS work and coordinate with Security.
- Legal timing: they want terms by 09/01. We may need flexible SLA language for PHI handling (possible exception) — looping Marissa for quick approval on a one-off SLA variant.

Suggested short answers to give Acme within 48 hours: final mode recommendation (we prefer Dedicated), a minimal SOW outline, and SOC2 artifacts (attached).

Ben
